packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 (the native port) is not supported by SvelteKit 3.1 (typescript ^6) or svelte-check (^5 || ^6) yet; lift this once they support it.
@playwright/test must equal nixpkgs' playwright-driver (flake check playwright-pin). The nix-hash-fixup workflow aligns it when flake.lock moves nixpkgs, so Renovate does not propose it.
One pull request for all npm minor and patch updates: each changes npmDepsHash, and separate PRs conflict on the lockfile and the hash.
